newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatar Emir urges U.S. to ease up on Iraq and Iran.
- Crackdown on software piracy; Dubai-based assembler found loading personal computers with illegal software.
- Singapore Ports wins $187 million Aden port deal.
- U.S. computer maker AST to start computer assembly at Dubai's Jebel Ali Free Zone after Samsung takeover.
- Emirates chairman Sheikh Ahmed says airline studying possibility of building hotel in Baku, Emaar Properties also considering joint investments in Azerbaijan.
